#   < Copyright (c) Ministerium fuer Schule und Bildung des Landes NRW
#   < Referat 135, Voelklingerstrasse 49, 40221 Duesseldorf
#   < E-Mail: svws@schule.nrw.de
#   > Copyright (c) 2026, Frank Pfotenhauer
#   < OF THIS SOFTWARE, EVEN IF ADVISED OF THE POSSIBILITY OF SUCH DAMAGE.
#   \ No newline at end of file
#   > OF THIS SOFTWARE, EVEN IF ADVISED OF THE POSSIBILITY OF SUCH DAMAGE.
# WHAT IS MEASURED: identical condition text, divergent copyright block, divergent GitHub label.
# WHAT IS INFERRED (flagged as such): that GitHub's matcher normalises a one-line copyright notice
# but treats a 3-line address block as licence text, pushing the body past its similarity
# threshold. This pass did NOT read the matcher's source and does NOT claim its threshold.
# THE CONSEQUENCE, which is the point:
# The estate presents to a licence-field harvester as a scatter of small Vue/TypeScript tools while
# its 9832-commit Java core — the actual student information system, and the only row in it with a
# PLACEABLE institutional holder — is invisible. The repository that matters most is the repository
# most likely to be dropped, because an institution is exactly the kind of holder that writes a
# three-line address into its copyright block.
# THE RULE: never establish a licence from a PLATFORM METADATA FIELD. Read the grant body.
# This KB already knew the converse (p217: a manifest CLAIM is not a grant). This is the same
# lesson from the other side: a platform's DENIAL is not an absence of grant either.
